briefTitle: A Study of a Selective ERBB2 Inhibitor (CGT4255), in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have histologically confirmed diagnosis of: Part A: Locally advanced, metastatic, and/or unresectable solid tumor with documented ERBB2-activating alteration or NRG1 gene fusion in blood and/or tumor or HER2 overexpression in tumor; Part B: Locally advanced, metastatic, and/or unresectable NSCLC with documented ERBB2 mutation in blood and/or tumor; Part C: Locally advanced, metastatic and/or unresectable breast cancer with documented ERBB2 mutation in blood and/or tumor or HER overexpression in tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Diagnosis and biomarker criteria vary by study part and do not fit a single standard typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0 to 1 for Part A. For Parts B and C, ECOG Performance Status must be 0 to 2.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: ECOG status thresholds differ by study part.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have clinically acceptable local laboratory screening results (clinical chemistry and hematology) within certain limits.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Lab screening values are not specified with concrete cutoffs in the source text.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received small molecule chemotherapy or anticancer therapies or radiotherapy within certain timeframes before first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout intervals with unspecified or generalized timeframes are not typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgeries (eg, craniotomy and thoracotomy) within 4 weeks of the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical washout window is not a simple lab or typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Treatment with palliative focal radiotherapy (cranial or extracranial) (eg, stereotactic radiosurgery or intensity-modulated radiation therapy) ≤2 weeks before the first dose of study drug; treatment with whole-brain radiotherapy ≤4 weeks before the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiotherapy washout timeframes are not standard typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Clinically significant cardiac disease.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac disease exclusion is subjective and judgment-based.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Resolution of toxicities from prior therapy to ≤Grade 1 (or baseline), including resolution of clinically significant laboratory abnormalities, before the first dose of study drug.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Toxicity resolution rule depends on investigator assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Restrictions on use of corticosteroid use to manage neurologic symptoms in different parts of the study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Corticosteroid restrictions vary by study part and require clinical context.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: minimumAge: 18 Years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: evidence quote was not a verbatim substring of the trial text
